versos.grego: Τὸ λοιπὸν προσεύχεσθε, ἀδελφοί, περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ Κυρίου τρέχῃ καὶ δοξάζηται καθὼς καὶ πρὸς ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you;
controles.kjv: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
controles.livre: Nas demais coisas, irmãos, rogai por nós, para que a palavra do Senhor continue seu percurso, e seja glorificada, assim como também entre vós;

versos.grego: καὶ ἵνα ῥυσθῶμεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀτόπων καὶ πονηρῶν ἀνθρώπων· οὐ γὰρ πάντων ἡ πίστις.

controles.web: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
controles.kjv: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
controles.livre: E para que sejamos livres de homens corruptos e maus, porque a fé não é de todos.

versos.grego: Πιστὸς δέ ἐστιν ὁ Κύριος, ὃς στηρίξει ὑμᾶς καὶ φυλάξει ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

controles.web: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.
controles.kjv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
controles.livre: Mas fiel é o Senhor, que vos fortalecerá e vos guardará do maligno.

versos.grego: πεποίθαμεν δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ἃ παραγγέλλομεν καὶ ποιεῖτε καὶ ποιήσετε.

controles.web: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
controles.kjv: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
controles.livre: E confiamos no Senhor quanto a vós, de que vós estais fazendo e continuareis a fazer o que vos mandamos.

versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ Κύριος κατευθύναι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας εἰς τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ εἰς τὴν ὑπομονὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.
controles.kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
controles.livre: E o Senhor guie vossos corações para o amor de Deus e a paciência de Cristo.

versos.grego: Παραγγέλλομεν δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ στέλλεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἀδελφοῦ ἀτάκτως περιπατοῦντος καὶ μὴ κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ἣν παρελάβετε παρ’ ἡμῶν.

controles.web: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion, and not after the tradition which they received from us.
controles.kjv: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
controles.livre: Mas nós vos mandamos, irmãos, no nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que mantenhais distância de todo irmão que anda desordenadamente, e não segundo a tradição que recebeu de nós.

versos.grego: αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε πῶς δεῖ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς, ὅτι οὐκ ἠτακτήσαμεν ἐν ὑμῖν,

controles.web: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
controles.kjv: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
controles.livre: Porque vós mesmos sabeis como deveis nos imitar; porque nós não fomos desordenados entre vós;

versos.grego: οὐδὲ δωρεὰν ἄρτον ἐφάγομεν παρά τινος, ἀλλ’ ἐν κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐργαζόμενοι πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν·

controles.web: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you;
controles.kjv: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
controles.livre: Nem comemos de graça o pão de qualquer um, mas sim com trabalho e cansaço trabalhamos de noite e de dia, para não sermos incômodos a nenhum de vós.

versos.grego: οὐχ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν, ἀλλ’ ἵνα ἑαυτοὺς τύπον δῶμεν ὑμῖν εἰς τὸ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς.

controles.web: not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
controles.kjv: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
controles.livre: Não porque não tivéssemos autoridade para fazer isso , mas porque nós mesmos dávamos exemplo a vós, para assim nos imitardes.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε ἦμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, τοῦτο παρηγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι εἴ τις οὐ θέλει ἐργάζεσθαι, μηδὲ ἐσθιέτω.

controles.web: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone will not work, neither let him eat.”
controles.kjv: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
controles.livre: Porque, quando ainda estávamos convosco, isto vos mandamos: que se alguém não quiser trabalhar, também não coma.

versos.grego: ἀκούομεν γάρ τινας περιπατοῦντας ἐν ὑμῖν ἀτάκτως, μηδὲν ἐργαζομένους ἀλλὰ περιεργαζομένους·

controles.web: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
controles.kjv: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
controles.livre: Porque ouvimos que alguns entre vós andam desordenadamente, não trabalhando, mas se intrometendo no que os outros fazem.

versos.grego: τοῖς δὲ τοιούτοις παραγγέλλομεν καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ ἵνα μετὰ ἡσυχίας ἐργαζόμενοι τὸν ἑαυτῶν ἄρτον ἐσθίωσιν.

controles.web: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
controles.kjv: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
controles.livre: Mas aos tais mandamos e exortamos, por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que trabalhem sem causar incômodo, e comam seu próprio pão.

versos.grego: Ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, μὴ ἐγκακήσητε καλοποιοῦντες.

controles.web: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing well.
controles.kjv: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
controles.livre: E vós, irmãos, não vos canseis de fazer o bem.

versos.grego: εἰ δέ τις οὐχ ὑπακούει τῷ λόγῳ ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ἐπιστολῆς, τοῦτον σημειοῦσθε, μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐντραπῇ·

controles.web: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
controles.kjv: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
controles.livre: Mas se alguém não obedecer à nossa palavra contida nesta carta, adverti-o, e não vos mistureis com ele, para que ele se envergonhe;

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐχθρὸν ἡγεῖσθε, ἀλλὰ νουθετεῖτε ὡς ἀδελφόν.

controles.web: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
controles.kjv: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
controles.livre: E não o considereis como inimigo, mas alertai -o como um irmão.

versos.grego: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Κύριος τῆς εἰρήνης δῴη ὑμῖν τὴν εἰρήνην διὰ παντὸς ἐν παντὶ τρόπῳ. ὁ Κύριος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.

controles.web: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
controles.kjv: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
controles.livre: E o mesmo Senhor da paz vos dê sempre paz em toda maneira. O Senhor seja com todos vós.

versos.grego: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου, ὅ ἐστιν σημεῖον ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιστολῇ· οὕτως γράφω.

controles.web: The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.
controles.kjv: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
controles.livre: A saudação de minha própria mão, Paulo, que é minha assinatura em toda carta; assim escrevo.

versos.grego: ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.

controles.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
controles.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.  The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
controles.livre: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com todos vós. Amém.
